title: Hidden in plain sight
body:
Compiled programs and data files keep readable text inside them. The strings tool prints it. Anything embedded in a file (keys, passwords, URLs) can be found this way.

Defenders: never hard-code secrets in programs, and scan builds and uploads for leftovers.

How to spot it: cat on a binary prints noise, but strings keeps only runs of readable characters. Look for things shaped like flag{...}, passwords, paths and web addresses in its output.
